en.headline: Happy Wednesday Oktoberfest and Beerfest continues at Happy Valley tonight
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club’s midweek racing night at Happy Valley Racecourse features Bavarian-themed entertainment on 7, 14 and 21 October.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club’s Happy Wednesday series continues tonight at Happy Valley Racecourse with the final night of its Oktoberfest and Beerfest programme. The events run on 7, 14 and 21 October from 6pm.

According to the Hong Kong Tourism Board and the Jockey Club, the nights include racing, live entertainment, Bavarian food and beer-themed activities. Public enclosure admission is HK$10, with free entry for visitors holding a valid travel document. Entrants must be aged 18 or above.

The series opened on 7 October with a ceremony involving the Consul General of Germany to Hong Kong and Macau and the Jockey Club chief executive. Tonight’s programme includes a performance by vocalist MsLolo. The Club said the events aim to combine midweek racing with festive elements.

zh.headline: 快活谷快樂星期三Oktoberfest及Beerfest今晚繼續
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會於快活谷馬場的周三賽馬夜，在十月七日、十四日及二十一日舉行巴伐利亞主題活動。
body: 香港賽馬會快樂星期三系列今晚於快活谷馬場繼續，為其Oktoberfest及Beerfest節目的最後一晚。活動在十月七日、十四日及二十一日晚上六時開始。
根據香港旅遊發展局及馬會資料，當晚包括賽馬、現場娛樂、巴伐利亞美食及啤酒主題活動。公眾席入場費10港元，持有效旅行證件的訪港旅客免費入場。入場人士須年滿18歲。
系列於十月七日開幕，德國駐港總領事及馬會行政總裁出席儀式。今晚節目包括歌手MsLolo演出。馬會表示活動旨在將周三賽馬與節慶元素結合。
